files.finding: The installed tutorial explicitly limits color swap to WSE-2; WSE-3 support is not available. Whole-region compile011 independently rejects color_swap_x.

Completion means source data have been copied into the output queue. Queue contents may remain in flight; changing that queue color requires queue flush. The P25 copy transport never reconfigures colors/queues and only reuses private source memory after completion.

source: Read directly from the installed SDK on workstation; no current-web-version equivalence asserted.
